product_overview: FICAI 4.0 is a municipal education platform for tracking student infrequency and preventing school dropout through guided case registration, case monitoring, and audited cancellation. It supports school-to-agency workflows, official A4 record generation, and georeferenced case visualization.
core_goals: Identify students with repeated absences early
Register official FICAI cases in a standardized A4 format
Track case history and follow-up actions over time
Preserve auditability and permanence for canceled cases
Support case monitoring through dashboard filtering and detailed case review
Help users visualize the route between the school and the student’s residence

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows authorized users to sign in and access the system session for dashboard and case operations.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the main dashboard
Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Toggle password visibility -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the main dashboard

features.name: Dashboard de Controle de Evasão
features.description: Provides an overview of active cases and lets users search, filter, and inspect student case information.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See the dashboard statistics and case lists -> Filter cases by student name or number -> Filter cases by turma -> Open a student row -> See the information modal
Navigate to / -> See the dashboard statistics and case lists -> Filter cases by student name or number -> Filter cases by turma -> Clear the filters -> See the full case list again

features.name: Gerar FICAI
features.description: Guides users through the six-step creation of a new FICAI, including student selection, absence details, school procedures, diagnosis, and print preview.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Start a new FICAI registration -> Select a school -> See student data populate automatically -> Fill in turma and absence period -> Mark school procedures completed -> Select causes and vulnerabilities -> Choose the evasion diagnosis -> Preview the A4 form

Navigate to / -> Start a new FICAI registration -> Select a school -> See student data populate automatically -> Fill in turma and absence period -> Mark school procedures completed -> Select causes and vulnerabilities -> Choose the evasion diagnosis -> Submit the FICAI record -> See the new case saved

features.name: Cancelamento de FICAI com Imutabilidade Auditada
features.description: Lets users search canceled FICAIs, review their audit summary, and submit cancellation requests that preserve immutable records.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the canceled FICAI section -> Search for a canceled FICAI by number, student, turma, or status -> Review the mini table summary -> Submit the cancellation request -> See the cancellation registered in the audit history
Navigate to / -> Open the canceled FICAI section -> Search the audit table by a canceled case term -> Review the matched historical record -> Confirm the canceled case details
